decisions: Ranks follow the army-style ladder used in the glossary character roles (Second Lieutenant, Lieutenant, Lieutenant Colonel), abbreviated to fit 7-byte slots: Sgt Maj, 2nd Lt., 1st Lt., Captain, Major, Lt.Col., Colonel. Each rank is stored at two addresses with the same text.
Faction names use glossary forms (Federation, AEUG, Titans, Axis, Neo Crossbone, Delaz); era tags (83), (ZZ), (F91) kept with a space before the parenthesis.
Skill names: Title Case, one word in 7-byte slots; kept pairs of near-synonyms distinct (Menace/Daunt, Spirit/Fervor, Strike/Bullseye/Lethal).
